title: AWS Step Functions conditional routing on an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness agent verdict
description: Route a batch of transactions on the verdict of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness agents. Risky batches wait for a reviewer who signs in with Amazon Cognito.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: An AWS Step Functions workflow reviews a batch of card transactions with three agents, each a call to the same Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness through the optimized InvokeHarness integration. A fraud analyst lists suspicious transactions, and a compliance specialist explains them and ends with a verdict token: RISK_IMMEDIATE, RISK_REVIEW or RISK_NONE.

A Choice state routes on the token. Clear fraud goes to a third agent that drafts a customer notification, then to approval. A RISK_REVIEW verdict, a missing token, an incomplete reply or a failed call goes to human review, and only RISK_NONE closes the batch without a person. Approval emails from Amazon SNS link to the Amazon Cognito sign-in page, and an AWS Lambda function behind Amazon API Gateway records the decision for users in the approvers group. Every outcome is stored in Amazon DynamoDB.
This pattern deploys one AgentCore harness, one Step Functions state machine, one SNS topic, one Cognito user pool, one HTTP API, one Lambda function and one DynamoDB table.
